<script lang="ts" setup>
import { $navigateTo, $showModal, computed, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'nativescript-vue';
import { Dialogs, SwipeDirection, type EventData, type SearchBar, type SwipeGestureEventData, type View } from '@nativescript/core';
import SessionDetail from './SessionDetail.vue';
import TrackFilter from './TrackFilter.vue';
import { applyFilterResult } from '../state/track-filter';
import { useConferenceStore } from '../state/conference-store';
import { listFavoriteAction } from '../state/session-detail';
import { toScheduleRows, type ScheduleRow } from '../state/schedule-rows';
import { rowSwipeReducer, rowTapAction, swipeActionLabel, type RowSwipeState } from '../state/row-swipe';

const store = useConferenceStore();
const swipeState = ref<RowSwipeState>({ openId: null });
watch([
  () => store.state.selection?.searchText,
  () => store.state.selection?.mode,
  () => store.state.selection?.selectedTracks,
], () => {
  swipeState.value = rowSwipeReducer(swipeState.value, { type: 'list-changed' });
});
const ready = computed(() => store.state.status === 'ready');
const loading = computed(() => store.state.status === 'idle' || store.state.status === 'loading');
const rows = computed(() => toScheduleRows(store.getters.scheduleGroups));
const emptyMessage = computed(() => store.state.selection?.mode === 'favorites' && !store.state.selection.favoriteIds.length
  ? 'No favorite sessions.'
  : 'No sessions match your search or filters.');
const templateFor = ({ item }: { item: ScheduleRow }) => item.kind;

function openFilter() {
  $showModal(TrackFilter, {
    fullscreen: true,
    closeCallback: (result: unknown) => applyFilterResult(store, result),
  });
}

function swipeRow(event: SwipeGestureEventData, id: number) {
  if (event.direction === SwipeDirection.left) {
    swipeState.value = rowSwipeReducer(swipeState.value, { type: 'swipe-left', id });
  } else if (event.direction === SwipeDirection.right) {
    swipeState.value = rowSwipeReducer(swipeState.value, { type: 'swipe-right', id });
  }
}

function openSession(event: EventData, id: number) {
  if (rowTapAction(swipeState.value, id) === 'close') {
    swipeState.value = rowSwipeReducer(swipeState.value, { type: 'swipe-right', id });
    return;
  }
  $navigateTo(SessionDetail, { frame: (event.object as View).page.frame, props: { sessionId: String(id) } });
}

async function changeSwipeFavorite(id: number) {
  await changeFavorite(id);
  swipeState.value = rowSwipeReducer(swipeState.value, { type: 'settled', id });
}

async function changeFavorite(id: number) {
  const plan = listFavoriteAction(store.state.selection?.mode ?? 'all', store.getters.isFavorite(id));
  if (plan.kind === 'add-then-alert') {
    store.commit('favoriteAdded', id);
    await Dialogs.alert(plan.dialog);
  } else if (await Dialogs.confirm(plan.dialog)) {
    store.commit('favoriteRemoved', id);
  }
}

function changeSearch(event: EventData) {
  store.commit('setSearchText', (event.object as SearchBar).text);
}

function clearLaunchFocus(event: EventData) {
  const search = event.object as SearchBar;
  if (search.android) {
    // Give the containing layout focus so Android does not immediately refocus
    // its first text input after SearchView.clearFocus(). Tapping still works.
    const parent = search.parent?.android;
    parent?.setFocusable(true);
    parent?.setFocusableInTouchMode(true);
    parent?.requestFocus();
    search.android.clearFocus();
    search.dismissSoftInput();
  }
}

onMounted(() => {
  if (store.state.status === 'idle') void store.dispatch('load');
});
</script>

<template>
  <Page class="conference-page" statusBarStyle="dark" androidStatusBarBackground="#ffffff">
    <ActionBar title="Conference" class="conference-action-bar" />
    <GridLayout rows="auto,auto,*">
      <SearchBar
        row="0"
        hint="Search sessions"
        automationText="Search sessions"
        :text="store.state.selection?.searchText ?? ''"
        :isEnabled="ready"
        color="#111111"
        backgroundColor="#ffffff"
        textFieldHintColor="#555555"
        @textChange="changeSearch"
        @loaded="clearLaunchFocus"
      />
      <GridLayout row="1" columns="*,auto">
        <StackLayout col="0" margin="8,12">
          <Button
            text="All sessions"
            accessibilityLabel="All sessions"
            :accessibilityState="!ready ? 'disabled' : store.state.selection?.mode !== 'favorites' ? 'selected' : undefined"
            :isEnabled="ready"
            textWrap="true"
            minHeight="48"
            padding="8,12"
            color="#111111"
            :backgroundColor="store.state.selection?.mode !== 'favorites' ? '#c5ddf4' : '#eeeeee'"
            @tap="store.commit('setMode', 'all')"
          />
          <Button
            text="Favorite sessions"
            accessibilityLabel="Favorite sessions"
            :accessibilityState="!ready ? 'disabled' : store.state.selection?.mode === 'favorites' ? 'selected' : undefined"
            :isEnabled="ready"
            textWrap="true"
            minHeight="48"
            padding="8,12"
            color="#111111"
            :backgroundColor="store.state.selection?.mode === 'favorites' ? '#c5ddf4' : '#eeeeee'"
            @tap="store.commit('setMode', 'favorites')"
          />
        </StackLayout>
        <Button
          col="1"
          text="Filter"
          automationText="Filter sessions"
          accessibilityLabel="Filter sessions"
          :isEnabled="ready"
          margin="8,12,8,0"
          @tap="openFilter"
        />
      </GridLayout>
      <StackLayout v-if="loading" row="2" verticalAlignment="center" margin="24">
        <ActivityIndicator :busy="true" color="#245a91" />
        <Label text="Loading sessions…" textAlignment="center" color="#111111" />
      </StackLayout>
      <StackLayout v-else-if="store.state.status === 'error'" row="2" verticalAlignment="center" margin="24">
        <Label text="Unable to load sessions." textWrap="true" textAlignment="center" color="#111111" />
        <Label :text="store.state.error ?? ''" textWrap="true" textAlignment="center" color="#111111" />
        <Button text="Retry" @tap="store.dispatch('retry')" />
      </StackLayout>
      <Label
        v-else-if="!rows.length"
        row="2"
        :text="emptyMessage"
        textWrap="true"
        textAlignment="center"
        verticalAlignment="center"
        margin="24"
        color="#111111"
      />
      <ListView v-else row="2" :items="rows" :itemTemplateSelector="templateFor" separatorColor="#dddddd">
        <template #header="{ item }">
          <Label :key="item.key" :text="item.groupTime" class="schedule-heading" />
        </template>
        <template #session="{ item }">
          <GridLayout :key="item.key" columns="*,auto">
            <GridLayout col="0">
              <Button
                :text="swipeActionLabel(store.state.selection?.mode ?? 'all')"
                :automationText="`swipe-action-${item.session.id}`"
                :visibility="swipeState.openId === item.session.id ? 'visible' : 'collapse'"
                :accessibilityHidden="true"
                horizontalAlignment="right"
                width="96"
                minHeight="48"
                @tap="changeSwipeFavorite(item.session.id)"
              />
              <StackLayout
                :automationText="`session-${item.session.id}`"
                class="schedule-session"
                :translateX="swipeState.openId === item.session.id ? -96 : 0"
                accessibilityRole="link"
                :accessibilityLabel="item.session.name"
                @swipe="swipeRow($event, item.session.id)"
                @tap="openSession($event, item.session.id)"
              >
                <Label :text="item.session.name" textWrap="true" fontSize="18" fontWeight="bold" color="#111111" />
                <Label :text="`${item.session.timeStart}–${item.session.timeEnd}`" textWrap="true" color="#333333" />
                <Label :text="item.session.location" textWrap="true" color="#333333" />
                <Label :text="item.session.tracks.join(', ')" textWrap="true" color="#333333" />
              </StackLayout>
            </GridLayout>
            <Button
              col="1"
              :text="store.state.selection?.mode === 'favorites' ? 'Remove' : 'Favorite'"
              :automationText="`${store.state.selection?.mode === 'favorites' ? 'remove' : 'favorite'}-${item.session.id}`"
              :accessibilityLabel="`${store.state.selection?.mode === 'favorites' ? 'Remove' : 'Favorite'} ${item.session.name}`"
              textWrap="true"
              padding="8,16"
              verticalAlignment="center"
              margin="8"
              @tap="changeFavorite(item.session.id)"
            />
          </GridLayout>
        </template>
      </ListView>
    </GridLayout>
  </Page>
</template>

<style scoped>
.conference-page,
.conference-action-bar {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  color: #111111;
}
.schedule-heading {
  background-color: #e9eff5;
  color: #111111;
  font-size: 18;
  font-weight: bold;
  padding: 12 16;
}
.schedule-session {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  padding: 12 16;
}
</style>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { $navigateBack, computed, onMounted } from 'nativescript-vue';
import { useConferenceStore } from '../state/conference-store';
import { parseSessionId } from '../state/session-detail';

const props = defineProps<{ sessionId: string }>();
const store = useConferenceStore();
const loading = computed(() => store.state.status === 'idle' || store.state.status === 'loading');
const session = computed(() => {
  const id = parseSessionId(props.sessionId);
  return id === undefined ? undefined : store.getters.sessionById(id);
});
const favorite = computed(() => session.value !== undefined && store.getters.isFavorite(session.value.id));
const placeholders = ['Share', 'Watch', 'Add to Calendar', 'Mark as Unwatched', 'Download Video', 'Leave Feedback'];

function toggleFavorite() {
  if (!session.value) return;
  store.commit(favorite.value ? 'favoriteRemoved' : 'favoriteAdded', session.value.id);
}

onMounted(() => {
  if (store.state.status === 'idle') void store.dispatch('load');
});
</script>

<template>
  <Page class="session-page" statusBarStyle="dark" androidStatusBarBackground="#ffffff">
    <ActionBar title="Session" class="session-action-bar">
      <NavigationButton text="Back" android.systemIcon="ic_menu_back" @tap="$navigateBack()" />
    </ActionBar>
    <ScrollView>
      <StackLayout margin="24">
        <StackLayout v-if="loading">
          <ActivityIndicator :busy="true" color="#245a91" accessibilityRole="progressBar" />
          <Label text="Loading session…" textWrap="true" textAlignment="center" color="#111111" />
        </StackLayout>
        <StackLayout v-else-if="store.state.status === 'error'">
          <Label text="Unable to load sessions." textWrap="true" color="#111111" />
          <Label :text="store.state.error ?? ''" textWrap="true" color="#111111" />
          <Button text="Retry" @tap="store.dispatch('retry')" />
        </StackLayout>
        <StackLayout v-else>
          <StackLayout v-if="session">
            <Label :text="session.name" textWrap="true" fontSize="24" fontWeight="bold" accessibilityRole="header" color="#111111" />
            <Label :text="session.tracks.join(', ')" textWrap="true" marginTop="12" color="#333333" />
            <Label v-if="session.description" :text="session.description" textWrap="true" marginTop="12" color="#111111" />
            <Label :text="`${session.timeStart}–${session.timeEnd}`" textWrap="true" marginTop="12" color="#333333" />
            <Label :text="session.location" textWrap="true" color="#333333" />
          </StackLayout>
          <Label v-else text="Session not found." textWrap="true" color="#111111" />
          <Button
            :text="favorite ? 'Remove from favorites' : 'Add to favorites'"
            automationText="favorite-toggle"
            :isEnabled="!!session"
            :accessibilityState="!session ? 'disabled' : favorite ? 'selected' : undefined"
            marginTop="16"
            @tap="toggleFavorite"
          />
          <Button
            v-for="label in placeholders"
            :key="label"
            :text="label"
            :isEnabled="false"
            accessibilityState="disabled"
          />
        </StackLayout>
      </StackLayout>
    </ScrollView>
  </Page>
</template>

<style scoped>
.session-page,
.session-action-bar {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  color: #111111;
}
</style>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { $closeModal, ref } from 'nativescript-vue';
import type { EventData, Switch } from '@nativescript/core';
import { useConferenceStore } from '../state/conference-store';
import { checkedTrackNames, setAllTracks, toggleTrack } from '../state/track-filter';

const store = useConferenceStore();
const draft = ref(store.getters.trackOptions);

function changeTrack(event: EventData, name: string) {
  // checkedChange also fires for programmatic updates; only a changed native
  // value should toggle the draft, not initialization or Select All / Reset.
  const checked = (event.object as Switch).checked;
  if (draft.value.find(track => track.name === name)?.checked !== checked) {
    draft.value = toggleTrack(draft.value, name);
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <Frame>
    <Page class="filter-page" statusBarStyle="dark" androidStatusBarBackground="#ffffff">
      <ActionBar title="Filter Sessions" class="filter-action-bar">
        <NavigationButton
          text="Close"
          android.systemIcon="ic_menu_close_clear_cancel"
          automationText="Close filter"
          accessibilityLabel="Close filter"
          @tap="$closeModal()"
        />
      </ActionBar>
      <GridLayout rows="*,auto,auto">
        <ScrollView row="0">
          <StackLayout margin="12,24">
            <Label text="Tracks" fontSize="24" fontWeight="bold" accessibilityRole="header" color="#111111" />
            <GridLayout v-for="track in draft" :key="track.name" columns="*,auto" minHeight="48">
              <Label col="0" :text="track.name" verticalAlignment="center" color="#111111" />
              <Switch
                col="1"
                :checked="track.checked"
                :automationText="`track-${track.name}`"
                :accessibilityLabel="track.name"
                @checkedChange="changeTrack($event, track.name)"
              />
            </GridLayout>
          </StackLayout>
        </ScrollView>
        <GridLayout row="1" columns="*,*" margin="0,12">
          <Button col="0" text="Deselect All" @tap="draft = setAllTracks(draft, false)" />
          <Button col="1" text="Select All" @tap="draft = setAllTracks(draft, true)" />
        </GridLayout>
        <GridLayout row="2" columns="*,*" margin="0,12,12,12">
          <Button col="0" text="Reset" @tap="draft = setAllTracks(draft, false)" />
          <Button col="1" text="Done" @tap="$closeModal(checkedTrackNames(draft))" />
        </GridLayout>
      </GridLayout>
    </Page>
  </Frame>
</template>

<style scoped>
.filter-page,
.filter-action-bar {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  color: #111111;
}
</style>
